title: SSTV Image Reception Log
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham-radio stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sstv:image
| stats count as images, values(mode) as modes by callsign
| sort - images
description: Keeps a log of slow-scan television images you have received and from whom, including special ISS SSTV events.
value: SSTV events like ISS transmissions are time-limited; a reception log is a satisfying record of the pictures you pulled from the air.
implementation: Ingest decoded SSTV metadata into `index=personal`; review received images by sending station and mode.
visualization: Table of received SSTV images by callsign and mode.

references.title: ARISS — amateur radio on the ISS

grandmaExplanation: It keeps a record of the pictures you receive by radio, including the special ones broadcast from the Space Station.
